nvidium.options.region_keep_distance.too:
How far to keep regions loaded after they leave the render distance.
Can cause visual issues — consider using a mod like Bobby instead and leaving this at Vanilla.
nvidium.options.automatic_memory_limit.t: Automatically sets the geometry memory limit based on available VRAM. Close and reopen the settings screen after toggling to edit the manual limit.
nvidium.options.max_gpu_memory.name: Max GPU memory
nvidium.options.max_gpu_memory.tooltip: Maximum GPU memory for terrain geometry. Chunks will be culled when this limit is reached.
nvidium.options.enable_temporal_coherenc: Reduces rendering artifacts when the camera turns quickly.
nvidium.options.translucency_sorting.too:
Controls how transparent geometry is sorted.
None: no sorting, minimal cost, can look bad
Sections: section-level sorting, matches Sodium quality, low cost
Quads: incremental quad sorting over multiple frames, may show brief visual artifacts
Sodium: delegate sorting to Sodium
nvidium.options.use_sodium_vertex_format: Uses Sodium's vertex format instead of Nvidium's. Less performant and uses more VRAM, but may fix compatibility issues with some mods.
nvidium.options.cull_degenerate_triangle: Skip triangles that don't cover any screen pixels. Improves performance.
nvidium.options.statistics_level.name: Statistics Level
nvidium.options.statistics_level.tooltip: Controls how much rendering statistics are tracked and displayed in the debug overlay.
nvidium.options.render_fog.name: Render fog
nvidium.options.render_fog.tooltip: Whether to render distance fog on terrain.
